|notes=Power, ability, forfeit, destiny and gameplay text agree with the January issue. The March 2008 erratum changes deploy from 6 to 5 and uses a larger overlay with the printed title Mara Jade With Lightsaber. The margin name remains Mara Jade, The Emperor’s Hand (V). The later lore omits the January base card’s standalone “Spy.” Both editions are Alien and Imperial under the period rules. The reissue PDF was created on 12 August 2008. [[:File:Holotable-OVS12-Mara-Jade-The-Emperor-s-Hand-v17.gif|Later historical composite]]. [[:File:VS12O-38-Mara_Jade_The_Emperors_Hand.png|Another January slip crop]]. The [[:File:OVS12-38-Mara_Jade_The_Emperor_s_Hand-remaster.webp|historical fan reconstruction]] uses the January deploy value but omits the inherited Imperial icon.
